summary.caller_location: Jal Mahal Road, near temple, Jaipur
dispatcher_actions: Dispatch ambulance to Jal Mahal Road, Jaipur immediately
Alert fire department regarding the bike fire

key_facts: A car hit a bike from behind on Jal Mahal Road, Jaipur
The bike caught fire as a result of the collision
Multiple people are injured and require urgent medical assistance
The call taker initially misheard the location as Jangarh Road, but the caller corrected it to Jal Mahal Road near the temple
summary.final_summary: An emergency call was received reporting a high-severity road accident on Jal Mahal Road near a temple in Jaipur. A car rammed into a bike from behind, causing the bike to catch fire and leaving multiple people injured. The caller urgently requested an ambulance. The dispatcher is sending medical help and needs to coordinate with fire and police services.
